### [`title_plane_spr_00`](../../../../src/data/title_sprites.asm#L6) `$2800-$283F`

*data*

Title plane, 12 frames of a roll (sprite pointers $a0-$ab). $70e6 starts at $a0; $74c5 steps sprite 0 every 4th count of $4018.
